{{External|rs|rsc=Nature-Rune|dw=Nature Rune}} {{Infobox Item |name = Nature rune |image = [[File:Nature rune.png]] |release = [[24 May]] [[2001]] |update = New magic system online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = Yes |noteable = No |options = Drop |examine = Used for alchemy spells. |value = 180 |weight = 0.000 |respawn = 200 |exchange = Yes |id = 561 }} [[File:Nature rune detail.png|left|120px]] '''Nature runes''' are [[runes]] used for transmutation spells such as [[Low Level Alchemy|Low]] and [[High Level Alchemy|High]] [[Alchemy spells|Alchemy]] and [[Superheat Item]]. They are also used for the spells [[Bind]], [[Snare]], and [[Entangle]], and several spells on the [[Lunar spellbook|Lunar]] and [[Arceuus spellbook|Arceuus spellbooks]]. They can be purchased from many [[magic shops]]. Nature runes can be crafted from [[pure essence]] by [[members]] with level 44 [[Runecraft]] at the [[Nature Altar]], granting 9 [[experience]] per pure essence used. Players with 91 Runecraft will always craft two nature runes per essence. Nature runes are one of the most popular non-elemental runes traded in [[RuneScape|''Old School RuneScape'']] because many players need the runes to train their [[Magic]] using profitable spells such as [[High Level Alchemy]] and [[Plank Make]]. Nature runes can be used to charge [[Bryophyta's staff]], allowing the player to save some runes and use spells that require nature runes without using an inventory space. ==Obtaining== There is a lava-surrounded island in high-level [[Wilderness]], south-east of the [[Demonic Ruins]], where 2 nature rune spawns can be [[Telekinetic Grab|telegrabbed]]. Each of these spawns yields 3-4 nature runes. There are also some located on an island near the [[rock crab]]s by [[Rellekka]] that can be telegrabbed. They can also be obtained by stealing from locked [[Chest (nature runes)|chests]] in [[Ardougne]] and [[Rellekka]]. A [[Thieving]] level of 28 is needed to pick the locks. [[Dark wizard]]s can sometimes drop 4 nature runes when killed. ==Runecraft info== Nature runes are crafted at the [[Nature Altar]] south-east of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]].
